close_reason: Fixed alongside two sibling idiom beads in commit 3cc7eab (.59, .62, .60 batched into one commit because each is 1-3 lines and each is in a file already touched in this review pass). cargo test, clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, rustdoc all green.
description: ws.rs:53-64 — the inner branches for type_name 'ChatTypingEvent' and 'ChatPresenceEvent' each use 'match serde_json::from_value::<X>(raw) { Ok(evt) => ChatWsFrame::Variant(evt), Err(_) => ChatWsFrame::Unknown { type_name: "X".to_owned() } }'. This is the canonical .map(...).unwrap_or_else(...) shape: 'serde_json::from_value::<ChatTypingEvent>(raw).map(ChatWsFrame::ChatTyping).unwrap_or_else(|_| ChatWsFrame::Unknown { type_name: "ChatTypingEvent".to_owned() })'. Engineering basis: the .map/.unwrap_or_else combinator chain is the established Rust idiom for 'transform Ok, fallback on Err' — three lines instead of four, and reads as the single operation it is. Pairs with sibling finding JMAP-26di.38 (the Unknown type_name doc/impl mismatch — that one's already filed; this finding is about the shape of the branches, not the value).
title: ws.rs typing/presence event match should be .map().unwrap_or_else()
